name: stri_subset_fixed<-
title: Select Elements that Match a Given Pattern

origin.description: Replace the strings that contain a literal pattern.
origin.usage: stri_subset_fixed(str, pattern, negate = FALSE, ..., opts_fixed = NULL) <- value

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: Character vector. The result has this length.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: Literal patterns. The pattern vector cannot be longer than str when str is not empty.

arguments.name: negate
arguments.text: If TRUE, replace the strings that do not match. An empty string is then replaced.

arguments.name: opts_fixed
arguments.text: Search settings. Overlap is ignored and warns.

arguments.name: value
arguments.text: Non-empty character vector written onto the matches, in order.

origin.details: A missing pattern keeps the original string. An empty pattern makes that element NA and warns once for each empty pattern. A missing string stays NA. value is recycled over the matches only. If that count is not a multiple of length(value), the unused elements are ignored and a warning is emitted. Case-insensitive search maps each code point with ICU u_toupper. A character whose uppercase form is longer than one code point is left unchanged, so ß does not match SS.
origin.value: A character vector the same length as str.
origin.example:
x <- `stri_subset_fixed<-`(c("ab", "ba", "cd"), "a", value = "Z")
sentence <- paste0('`stri_subset_fixed<-`(c("ab", "ba", "cd"), "a", value="Z") returns ', paste(x, collapse = ", "), '.')
writeLines(sentence)

translation.description: Replace the strings that contain a literal pattern.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: String, missing value, number, logical, or list of those. None is an empty vector.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: Literal pattern or list of patterns. It cannot be longer than str when str is not empty.

arguments.name: negate
arguments.text: If true, replace the strings that do not match. An empty string is then replaced.

arguments.name: opts_fixed
arguments.text: None, or a dict of search settings. Overlap is ignored and warns.

arguments.name: kwargs
arguments.text: Further settings passed to stri_opts_fixed when any are supplied.

arguments.name: value
arguments.text: Replacement strings written onto the matches, in order.

translation.details: Matching is stri_subset_fixed. A missing pattern keeps the original string. An empty pattern makes that element NA and warns once for each empty pattern. A missing string stays NA. value is recycled over the matches only. If that count is not a multiple of the length of value, the unused elements are ignored and a warning is emitted. Case-insensitive search maps each code point with ICU u_toupper. A character whose uppercase form is longer than one code point is left unchanged, so ß does not match SS. The result is a new list.
translation.value: A list the same length as str.
translation.example:
from stringi.subset import stri_subset_fixed_assign
x = stri_subset_fixed_assign(["ab", "ba", "cd"], "a", value="Z")
print('`stri_subset_fixed<-`(["ab", "ba", "cd"], "a", value="Z") returns ' + ", ".join(x) + ".")
